examples.text:
How late each file's picture is against its sound (each clip shows its picture that much later, so lips match the voice):
  cam  camera.mp4  camera  80 ms
New camera takes keep their picture as recorded (sidecut sync <seconds> --default sets a delay for them).

Still going after 0.1 s, when the wait timed out:
  voice.wav: running 25%
Run the same `sidecut wait` again to keep waiting.

Asked for transcripts of:
  voice.wav (voice): ready, 2 words
`sidecut transcript voice` reads it.

Since revision 2 (now revision 3): 1 added.
  added  c  V1 Camera  00:00.000-00:01.000  Camera
Full detail (each clip before and after) with --json. Put clips back with sidecut restore --from <revision or file> --clips <ids>.

Restore 1 clip as it was in revision 2 (dry run, revision 3):
  change back  c  V1 Camera  00:00.000-00:01.000  Camera: position
Nothing changed yet. Run again with --apply (or apply: true) to restore them. Transitions, media and markers aren't restored.

1 clip (revision 2):
  c  V1 Camera  00:00.000-00:01.000  Camera  off
